demo_out=[[2]*12,[6,6,2,6,6,6,6,6,6,2,6,6],[6,6,2,6,6,0,6,6,6,2,6,6],[6,6,2,6,6,6,6,0,6,2,6,6],[6,6,2,6,6,6,6,6,6,2,6,6],[6,6,2,0,6,0,0,6,6,2,0,6],[6,6,2,6,0,6,6,6,6,2,6,6]]
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if all(value == row[0] for value in row):
            out[r] = [2] * w
    for c in range(w):
        if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)):
            for r in range(h):
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
